name: explorer-mixed-type-category
goal: Shared type modules that also own a runtime error class are listed under Types instead of dropped from every category.

evidence: explorerCategory (packages/reports/src/utils/explorer-ui/explorerCategory.ts:36-43) returns null for a model unit owning interfaces plus a non-table runtime class, so desktop.model.agent-runner-types (RunCancelled), remote.model.remote-types (RemoteFailure) and remote.model.remote-secure-types (SecureFailure) appear under neither Models nor Types. Expected: Types, with role Type definitions; a class-only module stays unlisted.

packages/reports/test/utils/explorer-category.test.ts matrix covered constants beside interfaces and class-only modules but no interface plus runtime class input; its registry policy test reads raw manifests only, so real source declarations were never projected. Strengthened the matrix with that input and the registry test with source-derived modelDefinitions.
